results.question: Show mills designed by architects born in Germany
results.sql:
SELECT m.id, m.name, m.location, m.type, m.built_year, m.notes
FROM mill m
JOIN architect a ON m.architect_id = a.id
WHERE a.nationality1 = 'German';

results.question: Show architects who designed every natural bridge
results.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT a.id, a.name
FROM architect a
JOIN bridge b ON a.id = b.architect_id
WHERE b.name LIKE '%Natural Bridge%'
GROUP BY a.id, a.name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bridge WHERE name LIKE '%Natural Bridge%');

results.question: List mills constructed during the Victorian era
results.sql:
SELECT "mill".*
FROM "mill"
JOIN "architect_mill_stats" ON "mill"."architect_id" = "architect_mill_stats"."architect_id"
WHERE "built_year" BETWEEN 1837 AND 1901;

results.question: Find the mill count for Frank Lloyd Wright
results.sql:

FROM architect_mill_stats 
JOIN architect ON architect_mill_stats.architect_id = architect.id 
WHERE architect.name = "Frank Lloyd Wright";

results.question: Show the longest bridge per country
results.sql:
SELECT b.location AS country, b.name AS bridge_name, MAX(b.length_meters) AS longest_length
FROM bridge b
GROUP BY b.location
ORDER BY longest_length DESC;
